race.comment: Open little race to start. RESONANT (2) just found one better at Pakenham Synthetic first up as favourite but should come on nicely from that. Nash Rawiller goes on and he'll take plenty of holding out. SCOVILLE (6) was good on debut behind a smart winner in Aroused who franked the form with a narrow second at Listed level on Saturday. She'll improve off that and sets up for a soft run. RUNNING RICH (3) resumes for his second campaign and can run well having bumped into a handy one in fast time on debut at Echuca. VIXEN VIBES (8) was sound on debut last time in and gets Damian Lane aboard, she can be running on late.
